metadata.display_name: GPT Image by Ace Data Cloud
metadata.short_desc: Generate one GPT Image 2 image and retrieve the same task through Ace Data Cloud.
metadata.desc: Generate one GPT Image 2 image and retrieve the same task through Ace Data Cloud. Configure your own Ace API key. /gptimage_ace shows help; administrators use /gptimage_ace_task for an existing task. This integration is provided by Ace Data Cloud.

api_key.description: Ace Data Cloud API Key for GPT Image
api_key.hint: Copy/create a dedicated key in Ace Applications → General application → Manage Keys. Allow /openai/images/generations and /openai/tasks. No Bearer prefix; never paste into chat. Masking does not encrypt the data directory.
